info.name: DMoney API Testing - Postman Assignment
info.description:
# DMoney API - Integration testing with Postman

End-to-end flow:

1. Admin creates 2 Customers, 1 Agent and 1 Merchant
2. Admin activates the users
3. SYSTEM deposits 5000 tk to the Agent
4. Agent deposits 2000 tk to Customer 1 (assert deposit commission)
5. Customer 1 sends 1000 tk to Customer 2 (assert service fee)
6. Customer 2 cashes out 500 tk from the Agent (assert service fee)
7. Customer 2 pays 400 tk to the Merchant

**Auth:** every protected request sends `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>` and `X-AUTH-SECRET-KEY: {{partnerKey}}`.

**Run order matters** - run the collection top-to-bottom (Collection Runner / Newman).

item.name: 05 - Transactions (deposit, send money, cash-out, payment)
item.description: End-to-end money flow with fee/commission assertions, plus negative scenarios.

item.name: TC18 - SYSTEM deposits 5000 tk to Agent

request.description:
SYSTEM account funds the Agent with 5000 tk.

**Expected:** 201 Created with trnxId.

item.name: TC19 - SYSTEM deposit below minimum amount (5 tk)

request.description:
Minimum transaction amount is 10 tk.

**Expected:** 400 Bad Request.

item.name: TC20 - Agent deposits 2000 tk to Customer 1 (assert commission)

exec: pm.test('Deposit commission is 2.5% of the amount (' + expectedCommission + ' tk)', () => {

request.description:
Agent cash-in to Customer 1. Deposit commission = 2.5% of the amount (2000 x 2.5% = 50 tk).

**Expected:** 201 Created and `commission` = 50.

item.name: TC21 - Agent deposit above maximum (10001 tk)

request.description:
Maximum deposit per transaction is 10,000 tk.

**Expected:** 400 Bad Request (or 208 soft-failure) - money must NOT be moved.

Transaction endpoints require a JWT.

**Expected:** 401 Unauthorized.

item.name: TC23 - Customer 1 sends 1000 tk to Customer 2 (assert service fee)

exec: pm.test('Send-money service fee is 5 tk', () => pm.expect(Number(body.fee)).to.eql(5));

request.description:
Send money has a flat service fee of 5 tk.

**Expected:** 201 Created and `fee` = 5.

item.name: TC24 - Send money to the same account

request.description:
from_account and to_account must be different.

**Expected:** 400 Bad Request.

item.name: TC25 - Send money with insufficient balance

request.description:
Customer 1 only has ~995 tk left (2000 - 1000 - 5 fee).

**Expected:** 208 (soft failure) or 400 - insufficient balance, no transaction id.

item.name: TC26 - Cash-out below minimum amount (5 tk)

request.description:
Minimum transaction amount is 10 tk.

**Expected:** 400 Bad Request.

item.name: TC27 - Customer 2 cashes out 500 tk from Agent (assert service fee)

exec: pm.test('Cash-out service fee is max(5, 1%) = ' + expectedFee + ' tk', () => pm.expect(Number(body.fee)).to.eql(expectedFee));

request.description:
Withdraw (cash-out) fee = 1% of the amount, minimum 5 tk -> max(5, 500 x 1%) = 5 tk.

**Expected:** 201 Created and `fee` = 5.

item.name: TC28 - Customer 2 pays 400 tk to Merchant

exec: pm.test('Payment service fee is max(5, 1%) = ' + expectedFee + ' tk', () => pm.expect(Number(body.fee)).to.eql(expectedFee));

request.description:
Payment fee = 1% of the amount, minimum 5 tk -> max(5, 400 x 1%) = 5 tk.

**Expected:** 201 Created, trnxId returned and `fee` = 5.

Customer 2 has ~90 tk left after cash-out and payment.

**Expected:** 208 (soft failure) or 400 - insufficient balance, no transaction id.
